paper_metadata.title: Effect of Nb and Nb5Si3 Powder Size on Microstructure and Fracture Behavior of an Nb-16Si Alloy Fabricated by Spark Plasma Sintering

evidence.quote: The influence of Nb and Nb 5Si3 powder sizes (Nb: 83.8, 37.4, 4.9 lm; Nb 5Si3: 86.4, 43.6, 2.9 lm) on microstructure and fracture behavior of an Nb-16Si alloy fabricated by spark plasma sintering (SPS) was investigated.
